rationale: super won because its false hard-constraint rate stayed at 0.00 while hard recall was 0.82, above Lightning's 0.59. Unknown preservation and repair did not improve when a Lightning audit was added, and the audit cost more, so the audit is not the default compile path.
selection_note: Audit arms reused cached compile calls, so their measured cost omitted the compile. cost_usd adds that shared compile cost before the tie-break. Super and super_audit matched on false hard rate, hard recall, unknown preservation, and repair. Super is cheaper, so it wins. The audit did not improve those rates.
